natspec.notice: One-shot initializer for a base ERC-1155 diamond — seeds the URI template (and registers IERC1155 + IERC1155MetadataURI via ERC-165). Delegatecalled by {Diamond.initialize} inside the initializing window (so it must NOT open its own pre/postInitializer; the `__ERC1155_init` guard passes because the window is already open). Companion to the {ERC20Init} pattern — a first-class production deploy artifact.
